summary: modernApp.test reproduces the five apps' validation block faithfully, keeps one image declaration and keeps secret values out of Groovy; the guide follows Ruling D1 and P3 and every example passes the controller's linter. One blocking defect: the secrets handoff through `kubectl set env -e -` silently truncates a value at `#` and splits it at a newline.

findings.summary: modernApp.test's secrets handoff (vars/modernApp.groovy:71-73) silently truncates a secret at '#' and splits it at a newline: kubectl set env -e - parses '#' as a comment, so the suite gets a wrong value with no error
